name: pi-pocket-dune
description: Every agent at work as Arrakis, for Pi Pocket: sietches, spice fields, ornithopters, and sandworms.
author: Brian Ketelsen

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && for f in dune/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --tab-width 4 --print-width 100 dune.ts dune/*.js dune/style.css test/*.ts README.md package.json
